rules: Original shrine source IDs attest a shrine-name relation, not birthplace, home, death, martyrdom or relic authenticity.
Exact names and historical IDs remain source-key candidates; abbreviated and competing keys are held.
Previously proposed aliases are not certified human identities.
Artwork subjects and user five-star scores are not approved production images.
Blessed remains distinct from Saint; groups and angels cannot be treated as single human biographies.
No new map pins, saints, Missal observances or image rights may be promoted from this registry.
The 24 curated variant leads overlap with eight of the nine previously documented aliases; Wenceslas is the additional prior alias. None creates a certified person identity.
W78 sourced alias lookup navigation is research-only and links existing source-index records; it is NOT a certified person identity, feast, relic, person-to-site relationship or canonical key rename.

For four matching Doctor/archive key pairs, retain both source keys and require Calendar owner's precise source-ID equivalence approval; Francis of Assisi stays held, Thérèse's earlier owner bridge remains unchanged.

The three shared relic owner-subject IDs are same-source-record references across literal shrine names, not authenticated relics or verified saint identity equivalences. Distinct saint subjects sharing a physical shrine remain distinct.
